sources.notes: Road surfaces are triangulated directly between this layout's saved road boundaries. Elevation follows the approximately 22 m terrain raster, not a survey of the road. Curbs are geometry-based illustrations on curved boundaries; their locations, widths, heights and colours are assumed, not extracted from imagery. Banking is unknown. The source is an open route or branch network, without one validated closed driving order. Choose an embedded component route for playback and recording; this network does not represent a single lap. Boundary coordinates and their separate feature-level licence are preserved. Imagery loads externally on demand; no image bytes or meshes are stored.

notes: The club Inner Circuit plan identifies the full northern hairpin, inner southern loop and eastern dog-leg. The independently mapped centreline measures 983.7 m, compared with the club rounded distance of 970 m. The outer gearbox shortcut and pit roads are excluded. Exact source coordinates are unchanged; historical alignment and direction remain provisional.

borderInference.note: Automatically inferred from RGB differences along cross-sections of the existing trace. Evidence scores are not calibrated positional confidence. Borders are estimates and have not been manually reviewed; shadows, trees, aprons, paint and imagery age can move the detected edge. Imagery resolution is not survey accuracy.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 22 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the midpoint of corresponding border stations, not an official length measurement. There is no saved GPS start gate; the simulation begins at the first trace coordinate. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.

notes: The club Gearbox Circuit plan identifies the full northern hairpin and long outer southern return, bypassing the inner loop and eastern dog-leg. The pinned source loop measures 868.2 m, while the published plan states 970 m. This discrepancy remains recorded; coordinates are not adjusted. Exact source coordinates are unchanged; historical alignment and direction remain provisional.
